PENNY · DESIGN PROPOSAL · V1

A little more clarity.
Everywhere.

A cohesive mobile-first redesign covering 79 screens and states, 26 reusable component definitions, four appearances, and desktop adaptation. All UI is editable vector, text and component data. This is a proposal; the application is unchanged.

Daily money

01 · Home

light · iOS

Home separates recorded remaining from projected remaining. Income and spending figures are not an account balance. Calendar and money-flow tools move into Explore your month.

light · iOS

Entry flows

08 · Add expense

light · iOS

Frequent categories are selected inline without a popup or page change. All categories opens the full list only when needed. Chips are static in this storyboard; implementation updates the selection in place and keeps the selected category visible even when it is not frequent. Keyboard scrolls above the save action. Failed saves preserve the draft.

Shared money

22 · Shared households

light · iOS

Household balances remain separate by month. A previous unpaid month remains visible even after the calendar moves on.

23 · Household / expenses

light · iOS

24 · Monthly balances

light · iOS

Monthly recording is available from the last calendar day of the month. Current-month early payment is recorded on an individual expense share instead. The second $60 suggestion to Alex remains in the scrollable list.

25 · Add shared expense

light · iOS

Only the payer can attach one of their private accounts. Members see the receipt, payer, total, shares, and history; the payer’s account details stay private.

26 · Split among members

light · iOS

Amount and percent modes expose one field per eligible member, including zero shares. Show allocated and remaining totals; disable save until allocations equal the receipt.

27 · Choose payer

light · iOS

28 · Shared expense details

light · iOS

Paid shares lock the payer, total, allocation, month and deletion. Details that do not affect the settled amount remain editable.

29 · Record paid share

light · iOS

The full eligible share is confirmed. Either the repaying member or original payer may record it. Stale or ineligible payments require reopening the latest expense.

30 · Record monthly payment

light · iOS

Once a monthly reimbursement exists, individual payment recording closes for that month to prevent double counting.

31 · People & household settings

light · iOS

Creator-only actions include invitation, rename, remove and archive. Remove or leave is blocked while monthly balances remain outstanding; past expenses stay unchanged.

64 · Penny is locked

light · iOS

While locked, hide all ledger content and open dialogs. Failed authentication keeps this screen visible; retry uses the same button. Do not replace the operating system biometric prompt with an app imitation.

78 · Desktop overview

light · Desktop web

At ≥1100px use the sidebar and a 12-column content area. At 768–1099px use a compact rail and two content columns. Below 768px keep the mobile navigation and one column. These are proposal breakpoints, subject to device testing.
